independentLayers.description: The modal layer on the floating layer foundation (dom/floating.ts): top layer for backdrop and popup, dismiss layer (Escape, outside press), focus scope (trap and return), scroll lock, the rest of the page inert, nesting.
Reference numbers for the popup's padding, radius, gap, width and viewport margin.

intent: Ask for input or show content in a window over the page, with the page set aside until it closes

properties.description: Whether the dialog is open. Setting it (attribute or property) fires no openchange; a trigger press, Escape, an outside press or a close part set it unless openchange is canceled.
Open at first connect when no open attribute is present (Base UI defaultOpen).
Base UI modal: true (focus trapped, page scroll locked, the rest of the page inert), trap-focus (focus trapped only) or false (the page stays interactive; focus leaving closes it).
Outside presses (the backdrop) do not close it; Escape and close parts still do (Base UI disablePointerDismissal).
Text of a generated title (an h2 that names the popup). Ignored when the popup has an authored title.
Text of a generated description under the title (aria-describedby). Ignored when the popup has an authored description.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between the popup's parts in units of u (0…8 in steps of 0.5); default the collection gap (2u).

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: the trigger is pressed, Escape is pressed, a press lands outside the popup, a close part is pressed, or (modal false) focus leaves; preventDefault keeps the dialog as it is

semantics.role: none (the popup is role=dialog, aria-modal while modal)

keyboard.action: open the dialog (the trigger is a button)
move focus among the popup's tabbables, wrapping (modal and trap-focus)

sources: the title (label property or an authored [data-part=title]) through aria-labelledby

content.children: Popup content (any elements), or authored [data-part=trigger], [data-part=backdrop] and [data-part=popup] children. Inside the popup: [data-part=title], [data-part=description], [data-part=actions] and any number of [data-part=close] elements (usually ui-buttons); an [autofocus] element takes focus on open.

constraints: The host draws no box (display: contents; the manifest's layout schema has no contents value): only its trigger takes space in the page.
The popup and backdrop stay in the DOM while closed (display: none) and enter the top layer (popover=manual) while open: no z-index, and no ancestor's overflow clips them.

Modal (the default) makes every element outside the popup inert (live regions excepted) and locks page scroll (html[data-scroll-locked]); both are undone on close, and when the host is removed while open.
Give the popup a title: it names the dialog. Put at least one close part in it for touch screen-reader users.
A dialog inside another's open popup is nested: no backdrop of its own; the parent steps back (data-nested-dialog-open, --nested-dialogs) and Escape or an outside press closes the nested one first.
Setting open from script changes it without an openchange event.

avoidWhen.when: Confirming a destructive or irreversible action.
avoidWhen.reason: An alert dialog (ui-alert-dialog) interrupts with role=alertdialog, does not close on an outside press and starts on the least destructive action.

avoidWhen.when: Content that slides in from an edge of the screen (navigation, filters, a mobile sheet).
avoidWhen.reason: A drawer (ui-drawer) is the edge-anchored sheet with swipe to dismiss.

avoidWhen.when: Showing or hiding a section in the page flow.
avoidWhen.reason: A collapsible keeps the content in the page; a dialog takes the page away.
